name: Lurker
detailed_description:
Lurker is a game where you have to find spies who move to fail the mission. It combines traditional psychological warfare in the lineage of mafia games with roguelike and various puzzle elements. Breaking away from the static confrontation structure between killers and citizens within turns or set behavior patterns, every moment of the game will be a series of unexpected variables. Uncomfortable cooperation with teammates you can't completely trust, and overcome difficulties that come randomly!

Spy Hunt

At the start of the game, the Lurker and the Watcher are assigned to each team member. The Watchers focus on successfully completing the mission or hunting down the Lurker. The Lurkers must not be caught until the end and cause the Watchers to fail the mission. You may even win by doing nothing.

Explore Hidden Elements

The game has main missions that must be cleared, submissions that must be cleared, and hidden missions that you cannot even check the content of. If you have enough time, try these side missions! Most side missions provide special loot to the player, which is also desirable for the lurker.

Winner Takes All

When the match ends, the winning side is given the opportunity to choose the loot first. Even after the session is completely over, you can decorate your base with these items and unlock various hidden features!
